findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "record_portal_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "record_bid_call" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_watches, update_bid_sprint, choose_alerts, add_automation, turn_on_automation, share_tender, open_bid_panel, set_up_tenda · Private data: assess_tender_fit, check_bid_readiness, draft_bid_response, add_tender_documents, add_to_pipeline, record_portal_account, record_bid_call, remove_from_pipeline, get_bid_draft · Public sink: get_tender_details, watch_tenders, update_bid_sprint, choose_alerts, start_bid_draft, add_automation, turn_on_automation, share_tender · Destructive: add_to_pipeline, record_portal_account, remove_from_pipeline, get_automation_library.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_watches, update_bid_sprint, choose_alerts, add_automation, turn_on_automation, share_tender, open_bid_panel, set_up_tenda · Private data: assess_tender_fit, check_bid_readiness, draft_bid_response, add_tender_documents, add_to_pipeline, record_portal_account, record_bid_call, remove_from_pipeline, get_bid_draft · Public sink: get_tender_details, watch_tenders, update_bid_sprint, choose_alerts, start_bid_draft, add_automation, turn_on_automation, share_tender · Destructive: add_to_pipeline, record_portal_account, remove_from_pipeline, get_automation_library

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
